title: 第272章 露娜被救起后，我朝，我怎么成流口水的了？
slug: 三角洲招募威龙创电竞gti
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

杨起家的直播间里，弹幕因为这一幕彻底炸了。

【不是，我看不懂了，女医丢枪给蜂医，蜂医不捡？】

【然后蜂医又自己把背包里东西丢出来再捡起来？这什么行为艺术？】

【我倒是能看得懂女医的操作！我猜这女医这是看那些视频看多了吧？就觉得蜂医群体里全是卧虎藏龙？】

【哈哈我也看过那个视频！就是一个蜂医被人丢了把AW之后，走着人皇步抖着枪就冲走廊去了，最后直接一枪爆头！】

【对就是那个！我当时看完都觉得离谱，评论区还有人说“我只是穷但我并不菜”什么的，挺有意思的！】

【所以女医这就是想碰运气？觉得万一这蜂医也是个隐藏大手子？】

【还别说，她还真蒙对了，这蜂医上把可是二十四发灭了一队的狠人。】

【但问题来了——他真是高手没跑了，那他为什么不接枪？】

弹幕继续刷着各种猜测。

【我觉得他是在等，等这队大哥死了之后再去认下一队。】

【有道理，只要他不开枪，对面进来看到他一只老鼠也不一定会杀吧？】

【待价而沽是吧？这蜂医心眼子可以啊。】

【但不对，他来回丢东西捡东西是什么意思？如果只是不想打直接摇头就行了，为什么还要那个动作？】

弹幕一时间陷入了集体困惑。

而也正是这个时候，一直盯着手机屏幕看蜂医视角的杨起家忽然“诶”了一声，像是想通了什么。

“我超威，我知道了！”

杨起家凑近镜头，一脸“我懂你不懂”的表情。

“他在找女医要钱！要雇佣费！”

【？？】

【雇佣费？】

“你们想啊，三角洲里面不是有一套卖命买命体系的是专门用来做三乘三任务的吗？那种情况下一条命值多少？机密局卡战备不穿衣服进去的话，一条命差不多就是一个小红或者金条的价格。”

“现在虽然不是要蜂医拿自己的命去卖，但女医想让蜂医去帮他们打架。那是不是得出钱？”

“尤其是对面还有AWM！打胸就死的玩意！你让人家去冒这个险，空手白嫖？”

“所以蜂医来回丢东西的动作就是在告诉女医——哥，出钱，出够了我就干活。”

【卧槽！】

【这么一说好像对上了！】

【绿裤子：免费的事不干，爷是有价格的。】

【笑死了，认大哥归认大哥，打工归打工，这蜂医是真把自己当雇佣兵了。】

【我们知道他确实能打，但女医不知道啊！她凭什么信一个上供绿裤子？】

杨起家摊了摊手，“所以嘛，这就看女医怎么选了。”

而此时的蜂医视角里。

那个蛊老板，也就是女医，在蜂医第二次将东西丢出又捡起之后终于停住了动作。她站在原地顿了有三四秒，然后忽然转头看向了自己那个残血在墙后架着的威龙队友。

虽然外部观众听不到他们队内的语音，但从两人角色之间短暂的对视，以及威龙随后微摇头的动作来看——他们应该是在讨论什么。

大概过了五六秒。

女医转回身，对着蜂医做了一个“点头”的动作，然后

她丢出了三个小金。

总计大约十五万。

蜂医的角色看了一眼地上的东西，然后左右摇了摇头。

“不够。”杨起家在旁边翻译，语气里带着看热闹不嫌事大的兴奋。

女医收起小金，犹豫了一下，又丢出了一张紫卡——正是总裁刷新的那张，价值大概三十八万左右。

蜂医再次摇头。

“还不够？”杨起家的眼睛都瞪圆了。

【这蜂医胃口不小啊？】

【兄弟他是冒着被AW一枪秒的风险，你觉得三十八万够不够？他这一个老太头都多少钱了？】

【说的也是，但问题是女医又不知道他真能打，万一花了钱打不赢呢？】

而画面里的女医，在被拒绝第二次后似乎也产生了动摇。

她的角色站在原地没动，像是在犹豫。

从她接下来的行为可以推断，她大概是在和队友说——这蜂医如果真是高手，为什么还会来上供认大哥？总不能是先装孙子再坐地起价吧？

但偏偏就是这个时候——

对面走廊方向传来了脚步声。

In Yang Qijia's live broadcast room, the barrage completely exploded because of this scene.

[No, I don’t understand. The female doctor threw the gun to the bee doctor, but the bee doctor didn’t pick it up?】

[Then the bee doctor threw the things out of the backpack and picked them up again?What kind of performance art is this?】

[I can actually understand the operation of the female doctor!I guess this female doctor has watched those videos too much, right?Do you think all bee doctors are crouching tigers, hidden dragons?】

[Haha, I’ve seen that video too!It was a bee doctor who, after someone threw his AW, rushed into the corridor while shaking his gun, and finally shot him in the head!】

【Yes, that’s it!I thought it was outrageous when I read it. Some people in the comment section said, "I'm just poor but I'm not good at it." It's quite interesting!】

[So the female doctor just wants to try her luck?Do you think this bee doctor is also a hidden master?】

[Not to mention, she was really deceived. This bee doctor was a ruthless person who killed a team with twenty-four shots.】

[But here comes the question - he is such a master that he didn't run away, so why didn't he take the gun?】

The barrage continues to circulate various speculations.

[I think he is waiting for the eldest brother of this team to die before he recognizes the next team.】

[That makes sense. As long as he doesn’t shoot, even a rat coming in from the opposite side might not kill him, right?】

【For sale, right?This bee doctor is very smart.】

[But no, what does he mean by throwing things back and forth and picking them up?If you just want to shake your head if you don't want to fight, why do you need that action?】

The barrage fell into collective confusion for a moment.

It was at this time that Yang Qijia, who had been staring at the bee doctor's perspective on his mobile phone screen, suddenly said "Hey", as if he had figured out something.

"I'm super powerful, I know!"

Yang Qijia leaned closer to the camera with an expression of "I understand but you don't".

"He's looking for money from the female doctor! He wants employment fees!"

【??】

[Employment fee?】

"Think about it, isn't there a life-for-life system in the Delta that is specifically used for three-by-three missions? How much is one life worth in that case? If the secret bureau is carded and ready to go in without clothes, one life is almost the price of a red or gold bar."

"Although we are not asking the bee doctor to sell his life, the female doctor wants the bee doctor to help them fight. Does that mean we have to pay?"

"Especially when there's AWM across the street! You'll die if you hit your breasts! Are you going to let me take this risk and get nothing for nothing?"

"So the action of the bee doctor throwing things back and forth is telling the female doctor - Brother, pay me. If you pay enough, I will do the work."

【Fuck!】

[That seems right!】

[Green Pants: If you don’t do anything for free, it has a price.】

[It’s so funny that if you recognize me as a big brother, you should recognize me as a big brother, and if you work as a part-time worker, then you should work as a part-time worker. This bee doctor really thinks of himself as a mercenary.】

[We know that he can indeed fight, but the female doctor doesn’t know!Why should she believe a man offering green pants?】

Yang Qijia spread his hands, "So, it depends on how the female doctor chooses."

At this time, from the perspective of the bee doctor.

The Gu boss, the female doctor, finally stopped after the bee doctor threw the thing out and picked it up again for the second time.She stood there for three or four seconds, then suddenly turned her head to look at her Veyron teammate who was standing behind the wall with residual health.

Although the external audience could not hear the voices within their team, judging from the brief look between the two characters and Weilong's subsequent slight shaking of his head - they should be discussing something.

About five or six seconds passed.

The female doctor turned around, made a "nod" gesture to the bee doctor, and then

She threw out three small gold.

The total is about one hundred and fifty thousand.

The bee doctor character glanced at something on the ground and shook his head from side to side.

"Not enough." Yang Qijia was translating next to him, with a tone of excitement that was not too big a deal to watch the excitement.

The female doctor put away the small gold, hesitated, and threw out another purple card - it was the one refreshed by the president, worth about 380,000 yuan.

The bee doctor shook his head again.

"Not enough?" Yang Qijia's eyes widened.

[Does this bee doctor have a big appetite?】

[Brother, he is risking being shot by AW. Do you think 380,000 is enough?How much does this old lady cost?】

[That's true, but the problem is that the female doctor doesn't know that he can really fight. What if he spends money and can't win?】

The female doctor in the picture seemed to be shaken after being rejected for the second time.

Her character stood still, as if hesitating.

It can be inferred from her next behavior that she was probably talking to her teammates - if this bee doctor is really a master, why would he come to confess to Big Brother?You can't pretend to be a grandson first and then raise the price, right?

But it happened to be this time——

There were footsteps coming from the opposite corridor.
